package.name: trnav_2ws_kinematics
package.description: 2WS (inline dual-steer) platform kinematics: TwoWsDualSteerIK (DualSteer IK), TwoWsCrabIK (CRAB sideways IK), TwoWsBicycleModel. Pure math (stdlib only, no ROS). Moved out of trnav_2ws_motion per the ADR-012 amendment (2026-07-04); the package lives under src/Control/Motion_Control/2WS/. Identifiers keep the ADR-012 triple prefix (files qd_*, classes TwoWs*, namespace trnav::motion::two_ws).
